messages:
Zoe Li: Heads-up: prototype for "safety mesh" auto-degrade UX is in staging. want ops + runtime input on error-trigger mapping and audit playback. https://staging.redwood/safety-mesh
Kyle: Quick q — do we expose per-route quota as a trigger? e.g. quota_exceeded -> gentle degrade.
Maria: Need clearer operator affordance: show what fallback was picked + why. audit logs should include signal weights and rollout_id.
Dan R: +1. Also an :info: badge for 'soft degrade' vs 'hard fail' in the Console. And an undo (sticky override) with TTL.
deploy-bot: safety-mesh service deployed to staging by Kyle (kyle) at 1799995600
Kyle: Example mapping I'm prototyping:
```
# signal -> action
errors >= 5m -> fallback:static-small-model
latency_p95 > 800ms -> degrade:reduce-context
quota:route_exceeded -> fallback:cached-response
```
Maria: Telemetry plan: sample 100% for first 10m of a rollout, then 1% steady. include hash of prompt set to detect regressions.
Dan R: Edge case: multiple triggers fire. propose priority order: errors > latency > quota > quality_score
Zoe Li: Agree on audit detail (include model variant, signal snapshots, rollout id). Let's do 15m huddle Monday 10 to finalize UX.
